subject: MAP kickoff: SummitCloud — draft & timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@summitcloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@summitcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: SummitCloud — draft & timeline options

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for a constructive discovery call today. As promised, attached is an initial draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on milestones, owners, dependencies, and target close. High-level summary below and a couple of proposed timeline options — please review and confirm the stakeholders who should be owners for each milestone.

Quick summary of next steps (high level):
- We clarify success criteria & production targets (you)
- Redwood will scope Dedicated capacity + pilot configuration (Marissa / Aditya)
- Security/compliance checklist (you + Redwood Security)
- Procurement & legal review (you + Redwood RevOps)

Attached: SummitCloud_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (milestones tab + dependencies)

Draft MAP (top-level):
1) Pilot scoping & config (Milestone)
   - Target completion: 2 weeks after kickoff
   - Owner: Redwood (Marissa / Aditya) / SummitCloud (Jordan)
   - Deliverables: pilot capacity plan, initial prompt set, latency SLAs to validate
   - Dependencies: access to sample traffic, NDA signed (if required)

2) Security & compliance review
   - Target completion: 3 weeks
   - Owner: SummitCloud Security (Priya) / Redwood Security
   - Deliverables: SOC2 artifact review, network architecture diagram, KMS plan
   - Dependencies: access to requested docs, test environment reachability

3) Procurement & contract (commercial)
   - Target completion: 4-6 weeks
   - Owner: SummitCloud Procurement (Tom) / Redwood RevOps
   - Deliverables: SOW, pricing commitment, purchase order / invoice schedule

4) Pilot execution & evaluation
   - Target completion: 6-8 weeks (from kickoff)
   - Owner: SummitCloud Engineering / Redwood Implementation (Aditya)
   - Deliverables: pilot run, performance report, go/no-go decision

Target close (GA/first paid deployment): 8-10 weeks from kickoff (dependent on procurement cadence)

Timeline options (pick one):
A) Aggressive — 6-8 week path (compress security and procurement)
B) Standard — 8-10 week path (recommended for enterprise cadence)
C) Extended — 12+ weeks (if additional compliance gates or procurement lead times)

Ask: Can you confirm by EOD Monday which timeline you prefer and the primary owner for each internal milestone (security, procurement, engineering)? If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff next week to walk through the attached spreadsheet and lock owners.

I’ll loop Aditya on any technical follow-ups; he’ll own pilot setup and perf targets.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: SummitCloud_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (milestones tab)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@summitcloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@summitcloud.com>, Tom Benson <tom.benson@summitcloud.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: SummitCloud — draft & timeline options

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear MAP. Priya and I reviewed the draft with Tom. A few notes and confirmations: 

- We prefer Timeline B (Standard — 8-10 weeks). Procurement may stretch to 6 weeks in the worst case, so keeping space is safer.
- Owners:
  * Security/compliance: Priya Singh (Priya will coordinate internal SOC2 artifact collection)
  * Procurement/commercial: Tom Benson (Tom will start drafting PO requirements)
  * Engineering/pilot: Jordan Lee (I will be primary for integration + data access)

- Dependencies: We can start the security artifact share this week — Priya will send a link to the requested docs by EOD Tuesday. For the pilot, Jordan — I can provision a test service account and sample traffic dump by Friday.

- One ask: can Redwood confirm a proposed pilot instance size (GPU spec and expected token throughput) so we can pre-clear network/firewall rules? Aditya, can you propose a baseline (e.g., 1x a100-80GB equivalent with X qps) in a short note?

If helpful, we’re available for a 30-min kickoff on Wednesday 10-10:30am PT. Otherwise, confirm stakeholders and we’ll hit the milestones in the RAP.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering
SummitCloud
jordan.lee@summitcloud.com | +1 (206) 555-0143

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@summitcloud.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@summitcloud.com>, Tom Benson <tom.benson@summitcloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: SummitCloud — draft & timeline options

Great — thanks for the confirmations, Jordan. Timeline B sounds good.

Aditya — see Jordan’s ask on the instance size and baseline throughput. Can you reply with a short baseline proposal (GPU spec, qps, expected latency under sample load) so they can clear network/firewall and procurement can size the PO? If possible, include a note about alternative lower-cost quantized config for non-critical traffic.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Aditya to propose baseline pilot instance + alternative quantized config (today)
- Marissa to schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff for Wed 10-10:30am PT (tentative) — sending calendar invite now
- Priya to share SOC2 artifact link by EOD Tuesday (SummitCloud)

I’ve attached the MAP draft again for ease of reference and added a comments column for owners to populate.

See you on Wednesday if the time works — invite incoming.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
